allocation_method.description: (Optional) Defines the allocation method: Static or Dynamic. Standard SKU requires Static.
allocation_method.title: Allocation method

domain_name_label.description: (Optional) Label for the Domain Name, used to generate an FQDN.
domain_name_label.title: Domain name label

idle_timeout_in_minutes.description: (Optional) Idle timeout in minutes for the Public IP (4-30).
idle_timeout_in_minutes.title: Idle timeout in minutes

ip_version.description: (Optional) The IP version to use: IPv4 or IPv6.
ip_version.title: Ip version

name.description: (Required) The name of the public IP. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
name.title: Name

resource_group_name.description: (Required) The name of the resource group in which to create the resource. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
resource_group_name.title: Resource group name

sku.description: (Optional) The SKU of the Public IP: Basic or Standard.
sku.title: Sku

sku_tier.description: (Optional) The SKU tier: Regional or Global.
sku_tier.title: Sku tier

tags.description: (Optional) A mapping of tags to assign to the resource.
tags.title: Tags

zones.description: (Optional) A list of availability zones. Standard SKU only.
zones.title: Zones
